description: Health, application performance, hardware correlation and diagnostics. Single mode: blue/solid. Bulk mode: orange/dashed. Panel descriptions explain each metric. Query attribution is recorded in dashboard_queries.yml.

panels.description: Reachability of the app metrics endpoint. Model readiness is separate.
panels.title: App exporter health

panels.description: One means the model is loaded and its exporter is reachable.
panels.title: Model ready

panels.description: Actual successful image attempts. Each image in a ZIP counts separately.
panels.title: Successful images since app start

panels.description: Includes validation, loading, queueing and generation.
panels.title: Active uploads

panels.description: Number of alert instances currently firing in Prometheus.
panels.title: Firing alerts

panels.description: Space available to ordinary users on the Ubuntu root filesystem.
panels.title: Root disk available

panels.description: Scrape health of the application, node exporter, Prometheus and alert receiver.

targets.expr: up{job="caption_app"} or up{job="node"} or up{job="prometheus"} or up{job="alert_receiver"}

panels.title: Scrape health of all targets

panels.description: Image attempts per second over one minute, including decoding failures. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Image throughput by mode and outcome

panels.description: Generation duration only. Histogram p95 is an estimate. Idle latency is undefined. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Inference latency: mean and p95

panels.description: One ZIP is one request. Partial means some images succeeded and others failed. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Completed upload requests by outcome

panels.description: Complete upload duration, including validation, queueing and any cold model load. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: End-to-end upload latency

panels.description: Summary _sum: cumulative observed request seconds since app start. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Summary: accumulated upload time

panels.description: Summary _count: one observation per completed upload, including failures. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Summary: completed upload observations

panels.description: Instantaneous counts. Pending images decrease as a ZIP finishes. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Active requests and pending images

panels.description: At most one model generation runs at a time. Other requests can wait. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Model currently generating

panels.description: Mean original image pixels before resizing. Unit: pixels per image. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Average decoded image size (pixels)

panels.description: Summary mean of selected image counts per valid ZIP. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Average ZIP batch size

panels.description: Submitted upload bytes per second. ZIP uploads contribute compressed bytes. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Uploaded data rate

panels.description: No data before the first successful caption. A rising value during inactivity is expected. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Seconds since last successful caption

panels.description: Cumulative submitted requests by session and mode in the current application process. One ZIP is one request. Counts reset on application restart. The first 32 session IDs are retained; later IDs share overflow.
panels.title: Client requests since app start

panels.description: LEFT axis: guest CPU percent. RIGHT axis: pending bulk images. Compare the same time interval. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Guest CPU during bulk processing

panels.description: Both are normalized to total guest CPU capacity. Their sampling windows differ. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: CPU: guest-wide versus caption app

panels.description: RSS already includes model tensors. These lines overlap in meaning and must not be added. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Memory: guest used, app RSS and model tensors

panels.description: RAM uses MemAvailable. Filesystem percent uses space available to ordinary users. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Guest RAM and root filesystem usage

panels.description: Virtual disk vda reads and writes. Cached inference can be CPU-heavy with little disk traffic. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Guest disk traffic

panels.description: Application process CPU time measured during serialized model generation, grouped by mode. One-minute average as a percentage of total logical guest CPU capacity. Other application threads can contribute during each measured interval. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axis: percent, linear scale.
panels.title: Single vs bulk inference CPU

panels.description: Estimated error counts over five minutes, separated by processing stage. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Errors by processing stage

panels.description: Validation failures over five minutes, such as invalid ZIPs and size limits. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axes use linear scales.
panels.title: Rejected uploads

panels.description: Webhook notification counts by alert and status; reset on receiver restart. No data before first delivery. Horizontal axis: time. Vertical axis: count, linear scale.
panels.title: Alert notifications actually delivered
